preconditions.expression: n >= 2 and m >= 1 and 1 <= s <= n and l >= 0
preconditions.description: Input constraints: number of cities (n) is at least 2, number of roads (m) is at least 1, capital city (s) is within valid range, and distance (l) is non-negative.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n and 1 <= ui <= n and vi != ui and 1 <= wi <= 1000 for vi, ui, wi in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities within valid range, and road lengths are positive integers up to 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(vi != ui for vi, ui in roads)
preconditions.description: No self-loops exist in the road network.

preconditions.expression: len(set((min(vi, ui), max(vi, ui)) for vi, ui in roads)) == m
preconditions.description: No duplicate roads exist between the same pair of cities.
The road network is connected, meaning there is a path between any two cities.

postconditions.description: The output is the total number of Super Duper Secret Missile Silos located in Berland, which are either cities or points on roads exactly at distance l from the capital (city s).
The number of silos is a non-negative integer.
